summary: Zimmer Biomet Holdings filed a preliminary Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for an offering of senior unsecured notes of unspecified principal, coupon and maturity (blanks left in the document). The notes rank pari passu with existing unsecured senior debt and structurally junior to subsidiary obligations; they carry optional redemption, a tax-redemption call at 100% and a change-of-control repurchase right at 101%. Joint book-running managers are Barclays, Citigroup, HSBC, Morgan Stanley and RBC. NYSE listing will be sought. This is a routine debt shelf takedown, not a special situation; watch pricing, tenor and use of proceeds for leverage signals.
